title: Heartcore (Hardcore Alternative)
description: (Made for the Heartcore modpack.) Is hardcore too annoying, and survival too easy? Than this mod is for you! Lose hearts after death, regain them by eating a Homunculus Heart!
body:
![Heartcore Title](https://i.imgur.com/3xuk2so.png)

Made for the Heartcore modpack! Is hardcore too annoying, and survival too easy? With this mod, you start with 6 hearts instead of 10, and every time you die, you lose a heart. Fear not, though, as crafting a Heart with a golden apple can add hearts back, up to the vanilla 10!

## Simple Heart System

- You start with 6 hearts instead of the vanilla 10 hearts.
- Every time you die, you lose a heart.
- If you lose all your hearts, you are put into Spectator mode, unable to play, just observe.
- You can regain hearts by crafting and consuming a Homunculus Heart, up to vanilla 10 hearts.

### Homunculus Heart

*A heart made out of rotten flesh and alchemy*. Craft it by surrounding an enchanted golden apple with rotten flesh in a crafting table. Once eaten, grants the user +1 heart. It won't work if you already have 10 hearts, though!
